speaker: abel_garnish
text: You are here at nine. The book is Saturday's book. Two stops, and I will not take a third off you because a morning is long.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the two stops. I am not fetching Nick to spend them for a room that has heard them.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick is not fetched. The songs stay as they were left. One stop in the owl. Sam is not called. A boy who is not in the pass should be at his bread.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then tell me what this morning is. I will not learn a new entrance for a yard that is not having us this afternoon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The roll, in a room. The Knave at two is not my bill. I am not in it, and I am not staying to pretend I am.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And I am not here to be counted, Will. We were civil yesterday. I can be civil at nine. Keep your tally shut and I will keep my additions in my mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stays shut. I have nothing to set under your name, and I am not going to invent a column for a quiet morning.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. Term ends tomorrow. The gowns are still thick in the yard today. I will not rehearse a thin house before it thins. Give me a door I know.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Nothing was bought. The new comedy stays off this afternoon's plot. Today's pass is the pass the Knave already has.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had a penny at the Old Swan. Davy says Sir Walter is gone with forty ships, and the Queen's blessing, and that it will rain. I have not counted them.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Forty is a handsome number for a man who was not invited to bless it. I hope her Majesty has been told. I was not at the blessing.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Let the rain stay on the river. We have a room, and the room is not a ship.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will not put forty ships into a cue. Walk the door, Abel, and let Will go home when the door is walked.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The door, then. You are not in the Knave, Will. Hear the first pass if you like, and go. I will not write you into a bill that does not have you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will hear it and go. I am not staying to play a part I am not in.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then go when you have heard it. I will be very good, and you will have nothing to write down about me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not writing you down. Walk it.
